jobs.label: Add an MCP server
jobs.meaning: connect a new MCP server, a tool source for the agents
jobs.note: IN-2. Opens the MCP server form of the Integrations console. It saves nothing. The pane is open to every member since D-EA-9 (2026-10-14), so this job carries its own bar_feature integrations: a member without the grant is not offered it. A holder without integrations:manage can still follow the link. The page then opens no form (it mounts the job only for a manager and only when the list exists), so the link is dead and harmless. The gateway refuses the write anyway.

jobs.label: Review connections
jobs.meaning: review the connections the company has made and their health
jobs.note: IN-2. A link job: the list of connections is where the work waits.

jobs.label: Connect an AI agent
jobs.meaning: connect an outside AI agent such as Claude Code to Metorite, or see and revoke their agents
jobs.note: WS-55 EA-4b (D-EA-9). A link job to the AI agents view of Integrations: the connect card and the member's own agents. Every member holds it, so it needs no feature. The two jobs above keep integrations.
